target_customer: Importers, exporters and internet companies outside the US that need USD accounts, cards and cross-border payments
problem: Cross-border payments for physical goods rely on slow, costly international bank transfers. HEVN settles through licensed local payment providers and domestic rails, with virtual accounts and USD cards.
business_model: Fintech platform on partner banks and EMIs: FX and payment fees, card interchange and account services; not a bank
product_category: B2B cross-border payments and virtual bank accounts

founders.name: Peter Volnov
previous_startups: HOT Labs, Web3 wallet company with a 15M user wallet

founders.name: Pavel Mitsevich
founders.background_notes: YC page says he has 1.2M YouTube followers.

competitors.name: Veem
competitors.what: B2B cross-border payments adding stablecoin accounts powered by Bridge

competitors.name: MoonPay
competitors.what: Fiat to stablecoin virtual accounts launched in New York

competitors.name: SquareFi
competitors.what: Business accounts with named IBANs using stablecoins as the settlement rail

competitors.name: KAST Business
competitors.what: Business account with cards, international transfers and stablecoin assets

technical_complexity.rationale: Relies on integrating licensed partner banks and EMIs; the hard parts are compliance, partner onboarding and reliability rather than novel technology. Founders ran wallet infrastructure for 15M users.

defensibility.rationale: Partner integrations and customer accounts create some stickiness but many players offer similar virtual accounts. Licensing sits with partners, not HEVN.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Several incumbents announced stablecoin and virtual account features in 2026; outcome for HEVN unknown.

market_need_then: Pain from slow and costly SWIFT transfers and non-US firms lacking USD accounts; HEVN's YC launch claims 12 customers and readiness in the UAE.

identity.logo: HEVN wordmark; brand kit linked in site footer but not viewed

branding.community_and_virality: Founder Pavel Mitsevich has 1.2M YouTube followers per the YC page. Third-party sites (TradersUnion) also cover the product as Hevn Finance.

brand_strength.rationale: Short invented name with an audience through the founder's channels, but no source shows brand-driven growth and the name looks like heaven without a clear meaning.

outcome_analysis: HEVN is an active Spring 2026 company with no outcome yet. A team that already scaled a crypto wallet to 15 million users brings product and audience skills, which may lower acquisition cost. The risks are heavy compliance dependence on partners, a crowded field adding stablecoin accounts in 2026 and regulatory exposure in several jurisdictions.
notes: Funding: VCBacked and FundedIQ list a $500K pre-seed in June 2026 with Y Combinator; both are aggregators and it is the standard YC deal, so unverified and not recorded as a round. The YC page lists no funding. Education unknown for three founders. Outcome search found no shutdown or acquisition; Volnov reportedly left HOT Labs before the HEVN launch. The one line description in the directory says exporters of physical goods while the YC page describes Brex for non-US companies.
